info.title: Queue OpenAPI for hitem3d/hi3d/split
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the hitem3d/hi3d/split queue.

x-fal-metadata.about:
Split a 3D model into parts.

Character split uses body-part templates with optional printable
joints; general split works on any model by granularity level.

joint.title: Joint
joint.description: Joint type added between character parts (used when model is 'character').

model.title: Model
model.description: Split model type: 'character' splits humanoid models using a template with optional joints; 'general' splits any model by granularity level.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, inputs are checked for safety before processing.

mesh_url.title: Mesh Url
mesh_url.description: URL of the input model to split. GLB, STL and OBJ formats are supported, up to 200MB.

export_format.title: Export Format
export_format.description: File format of the generated model. Character split currently supports only 'glb'.

part.title: Part
part.description: Character split template (used when model is 'character'): 'a' 6 parts, 'b' 5 parts, 'c' 4 parts excluding head, 'd' 4 parts including head, 'e' 3 parts, 'f' 2 parts.

Hi3dSplitInput.title: SplitInput
Hi3dSplitInput.description: Input for splitting a 3D model into parts.

thumbnail.description: Preview image of the generated model, when available.

Hi3dSplitOutput.title: Hitem3DOutput
Hi3dSplitOutput.description: Output of the 3D model generation endpoints.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
